newsitem.title: USA: Digital introduces new notebook PC line.
newsitem.headline: Digital introduces new notebook PC line.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp Monday introduced the first two notebook personal computers of its new HiNote Ultra 2000 series.

Digital said the new models, which should retail for about $5,000 to $6,000, have 12.1-inch and 14.1-inch screens with starting weights of about five pounds; a profile 1.25 inches thin; multimedia, graphics and desktop capabilities.
The company added the HiNote Ultra 2000 also features a 20X CD-ROM drive, a "hot swappable" CD-ROM/diskette drive, and an international 56Kbps integrated modem.
